details: Bitcoin is showing signs of recovery, trading above $61,000, with Ethereum and XRP also experiencing subtle gains. This indicates a gradual return of buyers following a recent macro-driven sell-off. However, overall market sentiment remains fragile due to persistent macroeconomic pressures and the anticipation of hawkish policies from the Federal Reserve.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum See Modest Gains Amid Fragile Market

details: A significant security breach on Binance on October 29, where hackers allegedly linked to North Korea stole approximately $6.3 billion, triggered substantial customer withdrawals. Although Binance covered the losses, the incident underscores vulnerabilities within major exchanges and raises broader concerns about the stability of stablecoins, especially those operating in emerging markets, potentially posing systemic risks to global financial stability.
title: Binance Hack Prompts Stablecoin Stability Concerns

details: The cryptocurrency market has experienced a six-week downturn, with notable declines in Bitcoin and Ethereum. This prolonged sell-off is attributed to a combination of factors including tightening market liquidity, ongoing geopolitical risks (such as uncertainties in the Middle East), volatility within the tech sector, and the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance driven by higher-than-expected US inflation data.
title: Geopolitical Risks & Hawkish Fed Drive Crypto Selloff
